Distance in miles from the subject property to an appraisal comparable sale. Grounded in taxonomy.json archetype THRESHOLD, category Product Specific — a distance limit (guideline ~5 miles urban) breached without an addenda explanation is a ratio/limit-breach condition.

The appraisal report's effective date. Grounded in taxonomy.json archetype THRESHOLD, category Product Specific — an age-since-effective-date limit (e.g. 120 days without recertification) compared against closing_date.

Days between the appraisal report's effective date and the closing date, derived at fixture-build time from appraisal_effective_date and closing_date (both doc truth). Grounded in taxonomy.json archetype THRESHOLD, category Product Specific -- the same appraisal-age limit (e.g. 120 days without recertification) appraisal_effective_date's own catalog entry already names; this field is the computed day-gap that check kind ratio_threshold (mode field_value) actually evaluates.
